scenario.summary: Guest searches a blog whose activation date is in the future and verifies the CMS results are empty.
steps: Open the CMS search results tab
stateChanges: Run-time blog created by the collection (code/title TDA-<runId>-..., activation date 30 days ahead, published) and deleted at teardown
evidence: blog = BLOG_NEWS_FUTURE_ACTIVATION_OF_STORE (NEW consumable key and collection, pending; user decision 2026-11-10): MaxwellsHardware has no blog with a future activation date (the sheet's 'SampleBlog' matches no record; MyBlog 'Sample Blog' is dated 1930, i.e. expired), so the resolver creates one per run with the v1 API: POST /BlogNews/CreateBlogNews (BlogNewsType Blog, active, ActivationDate now+30 days, ExpirationDate now+60 days, SEO title = code = TDA-<runId>-<suffix>), POST /BlogNews/PublishBlogNews, teardown POST /BlogNews/DeleteBlogNews. v2 has no blog delete, so v1 per apiChoices.
The sheet's SampleBlog/SEOPageTitle is the term searched: blog.seoTitle (the created record's SEO title). No preferred: the record is created per run.
Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium pdp/quickOrder entries.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-10) where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, map key prefixes, regex) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap / getHashMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
